text: The first architecture decision: QAOA at depth p=2, tuned by COBYLA, implemented in Qiskit.
Develop first on Qiskit Aer's noiseless AerSimulator, to validate the approach before any hardware noise enters the picture.
Then test on real hardware -- ibm_brisbane -- through IBM Quantum's free tier, not a paid or dedicated access tier.
Why: Helena's real worry is spending real budget chasing a result nobody has verified yet.
Next: designing the portfolio QUBO -- encoding return, risk, and the cardinality constraint.
